_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "memo" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catch_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "genre" TEXT NOT NULL, "fished_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "point_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES points (id), "lat" REAL NULL, "lng" REAL NULL, "memo" TEXT NULL, "genre_detail" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "env" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catch_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "log_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catch_logs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "species_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "length_cm" REAL NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "memo" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "point_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES points (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "distance_m" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "encoded_polyline" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_points" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "speed_mps" REAL NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "point_candidates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "dwell_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forecast_cache" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "share_imports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "point_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES points (id), "payload_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teams" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "remainder_rule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'payer', "treasurer_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "participant_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "settled_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_catch_log_fished_at ON catch_logs (fished_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_catch_item_log_id ON catch_items (log_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_point_lat_lng ON points (lat, lng)
CREATE INDEX idx_track_started_at ON tracks (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_team_member_team ON team_members (team_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_trip_team ON trips (team_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_trip_expense_trip ON trip_expenses (trip_id)
